For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Growth Marketing Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Channel oversight & growth

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels
  • Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting
  • Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives
  • Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture
  • Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth
  • Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance


2.CRM & automation

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements
  • Monitor referral and client retention metrics, supporting sales with data-driven insights


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in data, dashboards and performance reporting
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Experience with B2B marketing and demand generation
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar)
  • Experience building and managing email marketing flows and automation
  • Hands-on experience with paid media (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads or similar platforms)


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
  • Experience with marketing automation tools beyond email (e.g., workflow builders, lead scoring)
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction industry


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interviews with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

Atuar como o parceiro estratégico e conselheiro de confiança (trusted advisor) dos nossos clientes, garantindo que eles obtenham o máximo de valor de negócio das soluções Sensedia.


A missão do CSM Pleno L3 é executar a estratégia de Customer Success na sua carteira, impulsionando adoção, acompanhando indicadores de saúde e atuando de forma proativa na construção e execução de planos de ação para retenção e reversão de churn, com orientação do time e da liderança, contribuindo para a sustentabilidade do Net Dollar Retention (NDR).



Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira: Construir e manter um relacionamento profundo com os clientes, entendendo seus objetivos de negócio, KPIs e desafios para desenvolver um plano de sucesso de longo prazo.
  • Capacitação e Evangelismo: Realizar workshops técnicos, demonstrações e sessões de capacitação para as equipes do cliente, garantindo que eles tenham autonomia e conhecimento para utilizar as soluções da melhor forma.
  • Condução de Ritos de Valor: Liderar reuniões executivas de negócios (QBRs), apresentando análises de performance, o ROI alcançado e o alinhamento estratégico para o futuro.
  • Monitoramento e Ação Proativa: Monitorar continuamente a saúde da conta através de dados e métricas (Health Score, NPS, uso de produto), identificando riscos e oportunidades de forma proativa. Construir, documentar e executar planos de ação para retenção.

  • Desenhar e Apresentar Soluções: Conduzir sessões de discovery técnico com os clientes para entender seus desafios de negócio e desenhar soluções funcionais utilizando as capabilities da plataforma Sensedia.
  • Orquestração de Soluções: Atuar como a voz do cliente dentro da Sensedia, mobilizando e colaborando com os times de Produto, Suporte e Vendas para orquestrar a resolução de desafios e garantir que os esforços internos estejam alinhados às prioridades do cliente.




Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência Comprovada: Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management ou Gerenciamento de Contas em empresas de tecnologia (preferencialmente SaaS ou PaaS).

  • Boa compreensão de conceitos de APIs e integrações de sistemas.
  • Conhecimento geral do design de APIs com Open API Specification / Swagger e modelos de segurança.
  • Noções básicas de arquitetura de software (microservices x monolithic).
  • Visão de Negócio e Dados: Familiaridade com as principais métricas de CS (NPS, Churn, NDR, Health Score) e capacidade de conectar soluções tecnológicas a resultados de
  • negócio.
  • Comunicação e Didática Excepcionais: Habilidade de apresentar, negociar e se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com diferentes públicos, do técnico ao executivo, e de conduzir workshops de capacitação.




Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Estar baseado em Campinas ou região (para visitas à clientes)
  • Experiência na gestão de contas Enterprise complexas.
  • Vivência na identificação e qualificação de oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell.
  • Conhecimento no ecossistema Open Finance Brasil.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de integrações.

Aqui você vai encontrar:


  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

description:

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.

Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native performance designer who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.

  • Version Control: Strong experience with Git (GitHub and/or Bitbucket) and enterprise branching workflows.

The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently.

You'll work closely with leadership, transforming technical knowledge into high-quality content, while reviewing and strengthening how the brand shows up across every touchpoint.

  • Research best practices and propose improvements to how Downtown communicates across channels
  • Be the first line of quality control on how the brand shows up externally


3.Demand generation & sales enablement

  • Create rich content (case studies, guides, studies, infographics) to educate architects and drive inbound demand
  • Support sales with enablement materials and educational assets

4.Optimization & performance

  • Ensure content is evergreen, performance-driven and SEO-friendly
  • Track results, test improvements and iterate


Requirements

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)

  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership

  • Comfortable working with multiple channels and priorities without losing consistency
  • Experience with content marketing or B2B communication

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
About the Team

SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.

Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources;
builds self-service andguardrails.

Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production;
builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.
  • Lead cross-team initiatives:
  • Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams;
    ensure adoption of architecture standards.
  • Run design reviews and architecture signoffs;
    surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.
  • Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.
  • Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.

Drive roadmap and execution:

  • Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.
  • Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).

Establish engineering excellence:

  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.
  • Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.
  • Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.
  • Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.
  • Champion security and compliance by design:
  • Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.
  • Guardrails in self-service flows;
    auditability and evidence collection.
  • Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.

Partner with the Architects:

  • Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.
  • Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.
  • Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.

Own delivery outcomes:

  • Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.
  • Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.
  • Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.

Operate a healthy on-call:

  • High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).
  • Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.
  • Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.

Initiatives You Will Lead:

  • Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.
  • AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.
  • Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).
  • Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.
  • Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.
  • Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.
  • Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.

Success Metrics

  • Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.
  • Improved lead time for change and change failure rate;
    increased automation coverage and reduced toil.
  • Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.
  • Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.
  • Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.
  • SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services;
    reduced alert noise viaimproved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).

What You Will Bring

  • Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.
  • Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB;
    Redis;
    messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.
  • Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.
  • Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.
  • Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.
  • Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.
  • Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).
  • Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.

What You’ll Need

  • Advanced skills in English
  • Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.
  • Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).
  • Database performance engineering and query optimization.
  • Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.
  • FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).

How We Work

  • Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.
  • Automation by default;
    security and reliability are nonnegotiable.
  • Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.
  • Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.

Tech Environment

Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).

Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).

Azure DevOps for CI/CD.

CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).

Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.

Caches: Redis.

Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.

Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.

Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

title: Infrastructure Security Specialist
description:
JOB PURPOSE:

The Infrastructure Security Specialist is a subject matter expert responsible for both the deployment ("Build") and ongoing operation ("Run") of solutions focusing on identity management, privileged access and the gatekeeper of our network security. Key operational ("Run") responsibilities for this role within the Infrastructure Security team include:

  • Executing routine identity lifecycle management tasks.
  • Managing exceptions related to network security policies.
  • Troubleshooting infrastructure supporting privileged access.
  • Ensuring the maintenance of secure hybrid cloud connectivity for both internal and external users.

Additionally, this role is responsible for ensuring compliance through regular internal and external audits of all deployed solutions.

JOB SCOPE/DIMENSIONS

  • User number: 12 000 IT users
  • Server number: 2400 owned
  • On premise Active Directory
  • SSO, IAM, PAM, Web Filtering, Audit
  • Hybrid cloud / applications

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Identity & Access Management (IAM): Manage the end-to-end identity lifecycle for internal employees and external contractors. Create and modify Active Directory and Okta accounts, manage Organizational Units (OUs), and assign specific security group memberships
  • Network Security & Firewall Operations: Administer website whitelisting and bypass exceptions for the Prisma Explicit Proxy. Manage and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewall rules, port openings, and network flows for critical business applications.
  • VPN & Remote Connectivity: Provision, configure, and troubleshoot Global Protect VPN access for users and third-party vendors requiring secure entry to the corporate network
  • Certificate Management: Generate, sign, and deploy SSL certificates (CSRs) for internal servers, external portals, and network appliances.
  • Core Infrastructure Support: Assist with routine infrastructure tasks including DNS record modifications, subnet mappings in AD Sites & Services, and DHCP administration.

INTERNAL & EXTERNAL INTERACTIONS:

Inside the company

  • Hierarchically attached to the Infrastructure Security Team Leader
  • Regional IT Department Heads to coordinate actions
  • Participate to project steering committee meetings in his perimeter
  • Governance committee member
  • Compliance & audit services

Outside the company

  • Infrastructure solution providers
  • Subcontractors related to infrastructure management
  • Auditors

JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

Education and Experience requirements:

Essential:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Engineering
  • At least 5 years experience of exposure to both in-house or outsourced systems, multiple hardware platforms, and integrated information management systems
  • Expertise in domain management, identity, privileged access and Network Security Operations
  • Maintain security end-to-end including firewall ruling necessary to any authentication activities
  • Fluent or native English speaker

Desirable

  • Palo Alto FW /Panorama/ Prisma Access
  • Project Management experience (V cycle or Agile)
  • Process/Procedure/SOP developments
  • Good troubleshooting and support skills (ITSM/Service Now, RCA)

In commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, this position is also open to candidates with disabilities.

title: Especialista De Integração | Customer Success Pleno
description:
Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.

Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + sobre a oportunidade:

Qual a missão do Cargo?

Atuar como o parceiro estratégico e conselheiro de confiança (trusted advisor) dos nossos clientes, garantindo que eles obtenham o máximo de valor de negócio das soluções Sensedia.

A missão do CSM Pleno L3 é executar a estratégia de Customer Success na sua carteira, impulsionando adoção, acompanhando indicadores de saúde e atuando de forma proativa na construção e execução de planos de ação para retenção e reversão de churn, com orientação do time e da liderança, contribuindo para a sustentabilidade do Net Dollar Retention (NDR).

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira: Construir e manter um relacionamento profundo com os clientes, entendendo seus objetivos de negócio, KPIs e desafios para desenvolver um plano de sucesso de longo prazo.
  • Capacitação e Evangelismo: Realizar workshops técnicos, demonstrações e sessões de capacitação para as equipes do cliente, garantindo que eles tenham autonomia e conhecimento para utilizar as soluções da melhor forma.
  • Condução de Ritos de Valor: Liderar reuniões executivas de negócios (QBRs), apresentando análises de performance, o ROI alcançado e o alinhamento estratégico para o futuro.
  • Monitoramento e Ação Proativa: Monitorar continuamente a saúde da conta através de dados e métricas (Health Score, NPS, uso de produto), identificando riscos e oportunidades de forma proativa. Construir, documentar e executar planos de ação para retenção.
  • Motor de Crescimento: Identificar, qualificar e nutrir oportunidades de expansão (upsell/cross-sell), trabalhando em estreita parceria com o time de Vendas para converter essas oportunidades em novas receitas.
  • Desenhar e Apresentar Soluções: Conduzir sessões de discovery técnico com os clientes para entender seus desafios de negócio e desenhar soluções funcionais utilizando as capabilities da plataforma Sensedia.
  • Orquestração de Soluções: Atuar como a voz do cliente dentro da Sensedia, mobilizando e colaborando com os times de Produto, Suporte e Vendas para orquestrar a resolução de desafios e garantir que os esforços internos estejam alinhados às prioridades do cliente.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência Comprovada: Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management ou Gerenciamento de Contas em empresas de tecnologia (preferencialmente SaaS ou PaaS).
  • Fluência Técnica Funcional:
  • Boa compreensão de conceitos de APIs e integrações de sistemas.
  • Conhecimento geral do design de APIs com Open API Specification / Swagger e modelos de segurança.
  • Noções básicas de arquitetura de software (microservices x monolithic).
  • Visão de Negócio e Dados: Familiaridade com as principais métricas de CS (NPS, Churn, NDR, Health Score) e capacidade de conectar soluções tecnológicas a resultados de
  • negócio.
  • Comunicação e Didática Excepcionais: Habilidade de apresentar, negociar e se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com diferentes públicos, do técnico ao executivo, e de conduzir workshops de capacitação.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Estar baseado em Campinas ou região (para visitas à clientes)
  • Experiência na gestão de contas Enterprise complexas.
  • Vivência na identificação e qualificação de oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell.
  • Conhecimento no ecossistema Open Finance Brasil.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de integrações.
  • Idiomas: Inglês Avançado (desejável)

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento;
    Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais;
    Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.
  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
  • Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;
)

title: Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior
description:
Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da SONDA?

Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.

Na SONDA você terá uma experiência de trabalho com diversas oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Um excelente lugar para aprender e contribuir para melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da tecnologia.

Procuramos Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato presencial no cliente na região do Parque São Quirino - Campinas e no horário das 09:00 às 18:00 (SEG/SEX)

Nesta função você irá:

  • Ser responsável por definir, desenhar e governar soluções de tecnologia da informação que atendam às necessidades do negócio, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade técnica, segurança, escalabilidade e viabilidade econômica das soluções propostas.
  • Atuará como elo entre negócio, times técnicos e stakeholders, traduzindo requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em arquiteturas robustas e sustentáveis.
  • Levantar, analisar e compreender requisitos de negócio, técnicos e regulatórios.
  • Definir a arquitetura de soluções (aplicações, integrações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança).
  • Avaliar e selecionar tecnologias, frameworks, plataformas e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Garantir aderência às arquiteturas corporativas, padrões, políticas de segurança e boas práticas.
  • Elaborar diagramas arquiteturais, documentos técnicos e especificações de solução.
  • Atuar junto aos times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e operações durante todo o ciclo de vida da solução.
  • Apoiar estimativas de esforço, custos, riscos e cronogramas.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos de mudanças e evoluções de sistemas.
  • Garantir escalabilidade, desempenho, resiliência, disponibilidade e segurança das soluções.
  • Orientar e apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores e arquitetos juniores.
  • Contribuir para a evolução da arquitetura corporativa e roadmap tecnológico.

Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior completo;
  • Domínio profundo de princípios SOLID, Dry e padrões de design.
  • Experiência em arquitetura baseada em camadas e separação de responsabilidades.
  • Experiência prática em ambiente Azure (incluindo serviços de computação, storage e redes) integrada à estratégia multi-cloud (AWS/GCP).
  • Experiência com esteiras de CI/CD para automação de deploy.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos, REST/SOAP e ferramentas de Gateway de API.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem lógica e física de dados para suportar as soluções desenhadas.
  • Capacidade fundamental para realizar a ponte entre a diretoria técnica, gestores de negócio e os fornecedores.
  • Habilidade para explicar decisões técnicas complexas e orientar o time na implementação dos padrões definidos.
  • Atuação com Tecnologias Chave (Stack): Cloud: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud | Identity: Entra ID, AD | Integrations: OIC, API Manager | Patterns: SOLID, MVC, MVVM, Microservices | Documentation: Draw.io, SharePoint.

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!

+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Faça parte da nossa equipe!

title: Especialista de Redes
description:
About Atos

Atos is a global leader in digital transformation with 107,000 employees and annual revenue of over € 11 billion. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, the Group provides tailored end-to-end solutions for all industries in 71 countries. A pioneer in decarbonization services and products, Atos is committed to a secure and decarbonized digital for its clients. Atos is a SE (Societas Europaea), listed on Euronext Paris and included in the CAC 40 ESG and Next 20 Paris Stock indexes.

The purpose of Atos is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education, and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

#WE'REHIRING

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Redes para atuar em um ambiente corporativo de grande porte, com foco em redes enterprise, data center e segurança. Procuramos um profissional com forte base técnica, perfil hands-on e visão estratégica, capaz de atuar desde o desenho até a sustentação de soluções de rede.

Modelo de Contratação

  • Cooperativa

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como especialista técnico em redes, apoiando projetos, operações e troubleshooting avançado.
  • Desenhar, implementar e dar suporte a infraestruturas de rede LAN, WAN e Data Center.
  • Definir e validar arquiteturas de rede (HLD e LLD).
  • Administrar e otimizar ambientes de switching e routing em nível enterprise.
  • Atuar na configuração e sustentação de soluções de segurança de redes (firewalls, VPNs e políticas de segurança).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas internas, stakeholders e fornecedores, como referência técnica da área.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria, migração e evolução da infraestrutura de redes.
  • Documentar topologias, configurações e procedimentos técnicos.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida como Especialista de Redes / Network Engineer Sênior.
  • Forte domínio em Routing: BGP, OSPF, ISIS, MPLS e SD-WAN.
  • Forte domínio em Switching: VLAN, Trunk, STP/MSTP, LACP, HSRP/VRRP, VPC e ACI.
  • Experiência com Segurança de Redes:
  • Firewalls (Cisco ASA, Fortinet e/ou Palo Alto)
  • VPN, IPsec e controle de acesso
  • Experiência prática em ambientes Data Center e redes corporativas de médio/grande porte.
  • Vivência com fabricantes como Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet e F5.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting avançado e ambientes críticos.
  • Inglês técnico (mínimo intermediário).
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Campinas/SP.
  • Disponibilidade para contratação via Cooperativa.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ambientes híbridos (on‐premises + cloud – AWS e/ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em automação de redes (Ansible, Python ou ferramentas similares).
  • Certificações como CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, JNCIP ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência prévia em grandes empresas, data centers ou provedores de serviços.

Here at Atos, we want all of our employees to feel valued, appreciated, and free to be who they are at work. Our employee lifecycle processes are designed to prevent discrimination against our people regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes them unique. Across the globe, we have created a variety of programs to embed our Atos culture of inclusivity, and work hard to ensure that all of our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute and feel that they are exactly where they belong.

title: SDR
description:
SDR (Inbound & Outbound)

Mobiis Campinas, São Paulo, Brasil

Sobre a Mobiis

A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e impulsionar a inovação na cadeia logística. Resultado da união entre Fretefy e Pathfind, a empresa oferece tecnologias avançadas como TMS, Marketplace de Fretes e APIs, ajudando clientes e parceiros a otimizarem seus processos logísticos com mais inteligência e escala.

Resumo da função

O SDR (Inbound & Outbound) será responsável por atuar na prospecção ativa e no atendimento de leads inbound, qualificando oportunidades para as soluções SaaS da Mobiis. Seu papel é identificar dores, entender o contexto do prospect, gerar interesse e agendar reuniões ou demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas, mantendo um funil de pré-vendas saudável e previsível.

Principais responsabilidades

title: Arquiteto De Soluções Sênior
description:
Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da SONDA?

Porque assim como você , amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.

Na SONDA você terá uma experiência de trabalho com diversas oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Um excelente lugar para aprender e contribuir para melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da tecnologia.

Procuramos Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Modalidade de Trabalho : Atuação em formato presencial no cliente na região do Parque São Quirino - Campinas e no horário das 09:00 às 18:00 (SEG/SEX)

Nesta função você irá:

  • Ser responsável por definir, desenhar e governar soluções de tecnologia da informação que atendam às necessidades do negócio, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade técnica, segurança, escalabilidade e viabilidade econômica das soluções propostas.
  • Atuará como elo entre negócio, times técnicos e stakeholders, traduzindo requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em arquiteturas robustas e sustentáveis.
  • Levantar, analisar e compreender requisitos de negócio, técnicos e regulatórios.
  • Definir a arquitetura de soluções (aplicações, integrações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança).
  • Avaliar e selecionar tecnologias, frameworks, plataformas e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Garantir aderência às arquiteturas corporativas, padrões, políticas de segurança e boas práticas.
  • Elaborar diagramas arquiteturais, documentos técnicos e especificações de solução.
  • Atuar junto aos times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e operações durante todo o ciclo de vida da solução.
  • Apoiar estimativas de esforço, custos, riscos e cronogramas.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos de mudanças e evoluções de sistemas.
  • Garantir escalabilidade, desempenho, resiliência, disponibilidade e segurança das soluções.
  • Orientar e apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores e arquitetos juniores.
  • Contribuir para a evolução da arquitetura corporativa e roadmap tecnológico.

Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior completo;
  • Domínio profundo de princípios SOLID, Dry e padrões de design.
  • Experiência em arquitetura baseada em camadas e separação de responsabilidades.
  • Experiência prática em ambiente Azure (incluindo serviços de computação, storage e redes) integrada à estratégia multi-cloud (AWS/GCP).
  • Experiência com esteiras de CI/CD para automação de deploy.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos, REST/SOAP e ferramentas de Gateway de API.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem lógica e física de dados para suportar as soluções desenhadas.
  • Capacidade fundamental para realizar a ponte entre a diretoria técnica, gestores de negócio e os fornecedores.
  • Habilidade para explicar decisões técnicas complexas e orientar o time na implementação dos padrões definidos.
  • Atuação com Tecnologias Chave (Stack): Cloud: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud | Identity: Entra ID, AD | Integrations: OIC, API Manager | Patterns: SOLID, MVC, MVVM, Microservices | Documentation: Draw.Io, SharePoint.

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!

+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Faça parte da nossa equipe!

description:

A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Atos is a global leader in digital transformation with 107,000 employees and annual revenue of over € 11 billion. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, the Group provides tailored end-to-end solutions for all industries in 71 countries. A pioneer in decarbonization services and products, Atos is committed to a secure and decarbonized digital for its clients. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

  • Experiência prática em ambientes Data Center e redes corporativas de médio/grande porte .

Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)

Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações

title: Implementation analyst
description:

Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer

Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.

Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.

Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:

Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.

title: Finance manager
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.
Requirements Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution. Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations. Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus. Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Gerente de Tecnologia da Informação (Setor Social)
description:
Descrição

A Fundação FEAC é uma organização da sociedade civil, com sede em Campinas/SP, que há mais de seis décadas atua na promoção da equidade e do desenvolvimento social sustentável. O Gerente de Tecnologia da Informação liderará a estratégia e a operação de tecnologia da FEAC, assegurando a confiabilidade dos serviços de TI, a evolução da arquitetura de dados, a integração entre sistemas, a segurança da informação e a adoção responsável de inteligência artificial nas áreas corporativas e finalísticas. Conduzirá portfólios de projetos complexos (PMBOK/Agile), alinhados aos objetivos de negócio, com foco em eficiência operacional, inovação e geração de dados para mensuração de impacto.

Responsabilidades

  • Estratégia e Escala: Definir e executar a estratégia de TI alinhada ao plano de expansão da Fundação, garantindo que a infraestrutura suporte o aumento do volume de operações aplicações, integrações, infraestrutura, serviços, segurança, dados e capacidades analíticas suportem a expansão institucional, a integração entre áreas e o aumento da complexidade operacional.
  • Transformação Digital: Liderar o diagnóstico, seleção e implementação de novas soluções de gestão (ERP, CRM e sistemas de gestão de projetos sociais) para substituir sistemas legados. Garantir que diagnósticos, arquiteturas, business cases e recomendações sejam traduzidos em decisões executáveis.
  • Gestão de Projetos: Gerenciar o portfólio de projetos estratégicos utilizando práticas do PMI e frameworks ágeis para garantir entregas rápidas e incrementais.
  • Dados e Impacto: Liderar a estratégia de Data Analytics (BI) para suporte à tomada de decisão e geração de relatórios de transparência e impacto para o Conselho e demais públicos de interesse, assegurando a evolução da arquitetura de dados integrada, com princípios fundamentais de Governança de Dados.
  • Compliance e LGPD: Estabelecer a Governança de TI e o compliance de dados, garantindo a plena adequação à LGPD, especialmente no trato de dados sensíveis de beneficiários.
  • AI e Automação: Definir e liderar a estratégia institucional de uso de AI, GenAI e Agentic AI na FEAC, priorizando casos de uso com valor para TI e para as áreas de negócio, com governança, segurança, rastreabilidade, supervisão humana e aderência às políticas institucionais.

ABOUT ROLE:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team and help drive and accelerate our growth. We offer a competitive salary and a fully remote work environment.
You will be working on a fintech platform focused on retirement savings, designed to simplify and improve how businesses offer retirement plans to their employees.
The platform helps companies — especially small and mid-sized businesses — provide accessible and well-structured retirement plans through modern technology. The solution automates investing, simplifies administration, and offers transparent pricing without hidden fees.
This project delivers a complete retirement plan solution with built-in compliance and regulatory support, making it easier for employers to offer strong financial benefits to their teams.
If you are passionate about building impactful financial technology and want to work in a fast-growing environment where your work directly improves financial well-being, this is a great opportunity to make a real difference.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Architect and scale our Fin Tech platform: Lead the design and evolution of our robust, cloud-based platform, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
Work with high performing global teams: Collaborate with our Europe-based engineering counterparts, fostering a culture of timely, on-budget delivery and continuous improvement.

Champion AI-driven innovation: Identify and integrate cutting-edge AI solutions to enhance our platform offerings and optimize development processes.
Collaborate across the organization: Partner closely with business and client-facing teams to gather insights, define product specifications, and prioritize initiatives to align with business and customer goals.
Embody decisive leadership: Own critical decisions, demonstrate strong accountability and ethics, and inspire confidence through clear communication and unwavering commitment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
6+ years of experience as a Backend Engineer or similar role.
Strong proficiency in Python and experience with modern Python development practices.
Hands-on experience with Docker (version 20 or higher) and Docker Compose for local development and deployment.
Experience with UV for Python package and environment management.
Solid understanding of database concepts and strong experience with Postgre SQL, including writing efficient queries and managing migrations with Alembic.
Proven experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs based on Open API specifications.
Experience with automated testing frameworks, particularly Pytest.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).
Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems (preferred).
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) is a plus.
Excellent problem-solving skills, with a focus on creating efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
WOULD BE A PLUS
Experience with performance optimization and scaling distributed systems.
Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools.
Contributions to open-source projects.
Experience with CI/CD automation.
BENEFITS
Opportunities to work on diverse and challenging projects
A supportive and collaborative team environment
12 vacation days per year
5 sick days per year
English classes
Access to therapist and psychologist support for mental well-being

description:
